description: Specialized shared observers whose target cardinality, entry-derived output, ownership, and teardown can make one cleaned raw observer the shortest contract-preserving implementation.

requiredAbsent.reason: Geometry comes from observer entries rather than synchronous layout reads

expectedBehavior: Runs the bundled scanner and retains both raw-io and raw-ro findings
Verifies target cardinality, callback output, ownership, per-target unregister, and owner-level disconnect before recommending a migration
Classifies the observers as no change when one cleaned observer remains the shortest implementation that preserves multi-target registration and entry-derived output
Does not generalize this exception to leaks, observer storms, duplicate subscriptions, or simple single-element visibility and size cases
